compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from the NBC News app, specifically under the "In-Depth" section. The main content focuses on news articles related to "Lethal Injection." The screen displays a list of articles with headlines and accompanying images. Each article headline provides a brief summary of the content:

1. "Drug in Spotlight After Inmate Heaves During Execution" - This article likely discusses a specific drug used in executions and its effects.
2. "Inmate Coughed and Heaved 13 Minutes Into Execution" - This article appears to detail an incident during an execution where an inmate experienced distress.
3. "Georgia Executes Inmate Who Refused to Appeal Case" - This article covers the execution of an inmate in Georgia who chose not to appeal their case.

The UI also includes navigation options at the top for "Home," "In-Depth," "Sections," and "Shows," along with settings for adjusting text size.
